sidebar toolbar -- renders the fixed omnichannel title and toolbar controls
sidebar section headings -- renders the platform's fixed navigation group labels
application footer branding -- renders fixed platform branding and footer navigation
sidebar footer information -- renders fixed platform help, branding, or status vocabulary
main application content -- renders only platform-authored onboarding, explanatory copy, and fixed navigation controls
main page heading -- renders a fixed platform section label
main subsection heading -- renders fixed platform interface vocabulary
main explanatory heading -- renders fixed platform interface vocabulary

platform feature cards -- renders fixed card labels and explanatory interface copy
feature-card buttons -- renders fixed platform navigation and action controls
feature-card links -- renders fixed platform navigation controls
